slides.title: Open your invite
slides.html:
Open the invite link or scan the QR code you got. Deploy App opens with your invite code filled in.

  • Only got a code? Type it in Enter your code and press Login with Code.

slides.title: Choose your callsign
slides.html:
Type a callsign your unit knows you by and press Continue.

  • You use the same callsign in every service.
  • It is also your certificate password.

slides.title: Get approved
slides.html:
An admin has to approve you.

  • Admin next to you: show them the QR code.
  • Admin somewhere else: press Send link and pick them in Signal, for example.
  • Leave the page open. It moves on by itself once you are approved.

slides.title: Get your key
slides.html: Press Download key. Safari asks about a configuration profile. Tap Allow, then Close.

slides.title: Install the key in Settings
slides.html:
Open Settings and follow the tiles:

  1. Tap Profile Downloaded.
  2. Tap Install three times and enter your passcode.
  3. Paste the password. Deploy App already copied your callsign.
  4. Tap Done and go back to Safari.

Then press Installed – continue.

  • Install failed? Remove the old profile in General → VPN & Device Management.

slides.title: Go to the service
slides.html: Press Go to the service. When Safari asks for your certificate, tap Continue.

slides.title: You're in
slides.html:
Deploy App opens. A short guide shows the first time. Press Next to go through it, or close it.

  • Tick Do not show me guides automatically if you don't want guides to pop up.
